headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Caleb Thielbar earning the win and Gavin Hollowell securing the save.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, including Rafael Flores Jr. of the Pittsburgh Pirates, who has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The move is retroactive to July 23, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies, Rafael Marchán of the Philadelphia Phillies, Addison Barger of the Toronto Blue Jays, Patrick Corbin of the Toronto Blue Jays, Jonatan Clase of the Toronto Blue Jays, Samuel Basallo of the Baltimore Orioles, and J.T. Ginn of the Athletics.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have made a trade, acquiring Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin, while the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Brewers 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Detroit**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Detroit Tigers, failing to secure a win. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI, while Tarik Skubal pitched 7.1 strong innings for the Tigers, striking out 12 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs Edge Pirates in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Caleb Thielbar earning the win and Gavin Hollowell securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a narrow win over the Washington Nationals, with Eduardo Rodriguez earning the win after 5.0 IP of relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Flores Jr. on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Rafael Flores Jr., catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The move is retroactive to July 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Marinaccio Joins Pirates in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ron Marinaccio has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for future considerations. The trade was announced on July 23, 2026.
